evidence: Median F0 drops from 127 Hz (ref) to 68 Hz (floor60) — close to a factor of 2×, suggesting octave-down tracking. F0 IQR simultaneously increases from 2.3 Hz to 62.3 Hz, indicating the lower floor admits many inconsistent low-frequency frames. conclusion: The 60 Hz floor very likely introduces sub-harmonic (octave-down) tracking for this male PD participant whose F0 is near 127 Hz. The 75 Hz and 90 Hz estimates are consistent. The floor60 result for Giovanni M should be treated with caution in sensitivity analyses.
